document_title: Learn how company-managed and team-managed projects differ
content:
The key difference between team-managed and company-managed spaces is how they are administered. Learn more about these spaces.
We have two ways to manage your spaces in Jira: company-managed and team-managed (formerly known as classic and next-gen). Find out how they differ, and which one is right for your space.
- Want to migrate from a company-managed space to a team-managed space, and vice versa? Here's how.
- Learn how we features differ between team-managed spaces and company-managed spaces in Jira.
- How work types differ between team-managed and company-managed spaces.
- Learn more about what makes configuring and setting up your team-managed space different from company-managed spaces.
